label: PRIMERGY TX1310 M5 tower server
description: Mono-socket tower server with two onboard gigabit RJ45 ports as standard, four 3.5-inch drive bays, four PCIe slots and iRMC S6 management shared on the onboard LAN rather than on a dedicated port.
notes: Fujitsu data sheet: 'LAN / Ethernet: 2' and 'onboard dual Gigabit LAN as standard'. Unlike the RX1330 M5 there is no dedicated management port in the interface table - iRMC S6 runs over the shared onboard LAN - so this model has two RJ45 ports, not three, and is the useful contrast when teaching out-of-band versus in-band management. Xeon E-2300/Pentium, 4 DIMMs to 128 GB ECC at 3200 MT/s, 4x 3.5-inch drives, RDX backup support, 4x PCIe (one Gen4). Data sheet is the maximum-component specification, so optional cards are not modelled.
